# refunds and credits

northwind cloud grants a refund window of 30 days from the date of each charge to request a refund, open the billing console, select the invoice, and choose request refund.

The starter tier allows 60 requests per minute, growth allows 300 requests per minute, and business allows 1,200 requests per minute # api rate limits

northwind cloud enforces api rate limits per project.

# uptime sla

northwind cloud guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime on the standard tier and 99.95% on the business plan the credit formula works as follows: 5% of the monthly fee for every 0.1% of downtime below the target, so credit percentage equals missed uptime divided by 0.1, multiplied by 5, capped at 50% of one monthly fee.

# data retention

northwind cloud keeps application logs for 30 days and backup snapshots for 7 days, after which both are permanently removed.

# encryption

all data stored on northwind cloud is encrypted at rest with aes-256, using keys managed by the platform key service encryption keys rotate automatically every 90 days, and business plan customers can trigger a manual key rotation from the console at any time.

# account onboarding

setting up northwind cloud takes about ten minutes third, open the console and generate an api key under settings and then keys; the secret is displayed only once, so copy it into a secure store.

The starter tier allows 60 requests per minute, growth allows 300 requests per minute, and business allows 1,200 requests per minute usage is counted in rolling one-minute windows, and every response carries an x-ratelimit-remaining header showing the remaining budget.

# status page

the northwind cloud status page is published at status.northwind.cloud and shows real-time health for every region and for core services such as the api, console, and dashboard incidents use three severity levels: severity 1 marks a full outage, severity 2 marks degraded performance, and severity 3 marks a minor issue without customer impact.

Growth adds email support with a first response within 24 hours, available around the clock # support tiers

support options depend on the plan.

# data retention

northwind cloud keeps application logs for 30 days and backup snapshots for 7 days, after which both are permanently removed when a project is deleted, associated data is purged within 24 hours, while backups simply expire on their normal schedule.

# compliance

northwind cloud maintains soc 2 type ii certification, renewed through an annual audit, and the report is available under nda from the trust center the information security management system is iso 27001 certified across all three regions.

Customers who need data removed sooner can request earlier deletion at any time by opening a support ticket; deletion on request finishes within 72 hours and is irreversible once the 24-hour purge completes a deleted project cannot be restored, so export anything you still need before deleting a project.

setting up northwind cloud takes about ten minutes a sample application can then be deployed with northwind deploy, and the starter allowance becomes available immediately after signup.

# regions

northwind cloud operates three regions: us-east (virginia), eu-west (ireland), and ap-south (mumbai) regional latency can be previewed from the dashboard before the first deployment, and the status page lists current capacity for each location.
Database point-in-time recovery is available for the entire 7-day backup window on every plan.
